purpose: Use the existing pinned Flutter source gate for narrow app-source changes without repeating unrelated Android/iOS builds.
behavior: Add source_qa_only boolean, default false. Full native producer and its existing dependency chain remain default.
Source-only mode runs the existing pinned-SDK approved-lock/pub-get/analyze/all-package-tests step and skips Android, iOS, materialization and lock bootstrap.
Dispatch run name explicitly identifies partial source QA. Conflicting source-only and bootstrap modes enter a required validation failure rather than silently skipping all jobs.
No new workflow, local runtime, release artifact, independent dispatch loop or native acceptance claim.
limits: A successful source-only workflow does not qualify native binaries, interop, devices, signatures or releases.
Root must audit all five active run statuses before the single sequential dispatch.
No native job or test requirement is removed from the default full producer.
hostedScope: Flutter source analysis and all86 package tests only; seven startup/save cases. Native/device/signing/release acceptance remains separate.
